arguments.code:
# Fetch all liked songs (paginated)
liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
page_counts = []
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    ids = [x['song_id'] for x in res]
    liked_song_ids.update(ids)
    page_counts.append((page_index, len(res)))
    print('page', page_index, 'returned', len(res), 'cumulative', len(liked_song_ids))
    # If fewer than limit returned, likely last page
    if len(res) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_liked_songs', len(liked_song_ids))
print('page_counts', page_counts)

# Determine which queue positions to remove (songs not liked)
queue_items = queue_res
not_liked_positions = []
for item in queue_items:
    song_id = item['song_id']
    pos = item['position']
    if song_id not in liked_song_ids:
        not_liked_positions.append(pos)

print('queue_count', len(queue_items))
print('liked_count', len(liked_song_ids))
print('remove_count', len(not_liked_positions))
print('remove_positions', sorted(not_liked_positions)[:10], '...')

# Also print titles for first few removals
rem_examples = []
for pos in sorted(not_liked_positions)[:5]:
    itm = next(x for x in queue_items if x['position']==pos)
    rem_examples.append({'position': pos, 'song_id': itm['song_id'], 'title': itm['title']})
print('rem_examples', rem_examples)
